verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report of routine point deletions at scale, which shows Qdrant supports deleting data. Nothing documents retention controls: no TTL or expiry policies, and no deletion API docs. Self-hosted storage volumes and snapshots do not count as retention controls. missing for 10: first-party documentation of delete APIs (by ID or filter), retention/TTL or automatic expiry policies, guarantees on purging deleted data from snapshots and replicas, and independent corroboration of retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
